findings.label: duplication
findings.failure_mode: The five required domain-pack section headings and the grep -qxF matching loop that checks for them are hand-copied identically in build-artifacts.sh (which already runs this exact check before calling validate-pack.sh) and in validate-pack.sh itself. The diff adds model/FORMAT.md documenting this contract while leaving the enforcement logic duplicated across the two files, so a future edit to the heading list in one copy silently leaves the other checking a stale set, and the two copies' error wording has already drifted apart.
evidence: .claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/build-artifacts.sh:52 — for h in the five heading strings / grep -qxF "$h" "$PACK" || MISSING_HEADINGS=...

.claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/validate-pack.sh:18 — the identical five-string list and grep -qxF "$h" "$PACK" || fail "missing or renamed heading (model/FORMAT.md §1): $h", a second hand-written copy of the same check with its own message
model/FORMAT.md:6 — new doc acknowledges build-artifacts.sh's extraction already assumed this exact contract, yet the diff still doesn't source the check from one shared file
